```{r libraries, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Data Preparation and Cleaning
### Load necessary libraries, covering data processing, multiple imputation, and modeling
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(mice)
library(lme4)
library(broom.mixed)

```


```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# --- 第一步：读取计算结果 ---
# 这里确保变量名与你之前的 DR 代码块一致
imp_data <- readRDS("stars_mice_mids.rds")      # 读入 mids 对象
stars1_wide <- readRDS("stars1_wide_final.rds") # 读入原始宽表（含 stayed_g3）
```


```{r}
# ====================================================================
# STEP 6: 20次插补全量 AIPW 估计 (纵向 Mixed Model 版)
# ====================================================================

m <- imp_data$m  
math_cols <- c("math_score_K", "math_score_1", "math_score_2", "math_score_3")
# 我们需要存储的是转换后的长表数据集，或者直接存储模型
# 预分配列表长度，避免未定义条目
dr_models_list <- vector("list", m)
failed_idx <- integer(0)

cat("开始在 20 个插补集上运行 Stage 2 (AIPW) & Stage 3 (Longitudinal Mixed Model)...\n")

for (i in 1:m) {
  # 1. 【安全提取】
  current_prepared <- complete(imp_data, i)
  
  # 2. 【即时加工】：补齐所有年级的 school_id 和其他控制变量
  current_prepared$student_id  <- stars1_wide$student_id
  current_prepared$stayed_g3   <- stars1_wide$stayed_g3
  # 补齐 K-3 的所有学校 ID
  for(s_id in c("school_id_K", "school_id_1", "school_id_2", "school_id_3")) {
    current_prepared[[s_id]] <- stars1_wide[[s_id]]
  }
  
  # 还原所有年级的数学成绩为原始 NA
  for(col in math_cols) {
    current_prepared[[col]] <- stars1_wide[[col]]
  }
  
  # 3. 【Stage 2.1: PS Model】：预测留在样本中的概率 (以 G3 为准或针对各年级)
  ps_fit <- glm(stayed_g3 ~ student_race + student_gender + birth_year + 
                free_lunch_K + area_type_K, 
                data = current_prepared, family = binomial())
  pi_hat <- predict(ps_fit, type = "response")
  
  # 4. 【Stage 2.2: 多年级 AIPW 计算】
  # 为 K, 1, 2, 3 四个年级分别生成 DR 伪结果
  for (g in c("K", "1", "2", "3")) {
    y_name <- paste0("math_score_", g)
    s_name <- paste0("school_id_", g)
    l_name <- paste0("free_lunch_", g)
    
    # 结果模型 (Outcome Model for Grade g)
    # 只使用该年级有成绩的观测值
    formula_out <- as.formula(paste(y_name, "~ class_type_K + student_race + student_gender +", 
                                    l_name, "+ area_type_K + (1 |", s_name, ")"))
    
    out_fit <- lmer(formula_out, data = current_prepared[!is.na(current_prepared[[y_name]]), ])
    
    # 预测值 (所有人)
    m_hat <- predict(out_fit, newdata = current_prepared, allow.new.levels = TRUE)
    
    # 执行 AIPW 公式
    y_obs <- current_prepared[[y_name]]
    r_ind <- as.numeric(!is.na(y_obs))
    
    current_prepared[[paste0("dr_math_", g)]] <- m_hat + (r_ind / pi_hat) * (tidyr::replace_na(y_obs, 0) - m_hat)
  }
  
  # 5. 【数据转换】：宽表转长表以支持 Stage 3 公式 (3)
  current_long <- current_prepared %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = starts_with("dr_math_"),
      names_to = "grade",
      names_prefix = "dr_math_",
      values_to = "dr_outcome"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      grade = factor(grade, levels = c("K", "1", "2", "3")),
      student_id = factor(student_id),
      school_id_K = factor(school_id_K)
    )

  # 6. 【Stage 3: Randomized Mixed-Effects Model】
  # 拟合公式 (3): 初始班级分配、年级交互、学校/学生随机截距
  fit_i <- tryCatch(
    lmer(dr_outcome ~ class_type_K * grade + student_race + 
         free_lunch_K + (1 | school_id_K) + (1 | student_id), 
         data = current_long),
    error = function(e) e
  )

  if (inherits(fit_i, "error")) {
    warning("lmer failed at i=", i, ": ", conditionMessage(fit_i))
    failed_idx <- c(failed_idx, i)
    dr_models_list[[i]] <- NULL
  } else {
    dr_models_list[[i]] <- fit_i
  }
  
  if(i %% 5 == 0) cat("已完成第", i, "个数据集的计算...\n")
}

# ====================================================================
# STEP 7: 汇总 (Pooling)
# ====================================================================

if (length(failed_idx) > 0) {
  stop("以下插补集模型失败：", paste(failed_idx, collapse = ", "), "。请先修复 STEP 6 后再运行 STEP 7。")
}

valid_models <- sapply(dr_models_list, function(x) inherits(x, "merMod"))
if (!all(valid_models)) {
  stop("dr_models_list 含非 merMod 模型条目，无法 pool。failed idx:", 
       paste(which(!valid_models), collapse = ", "))
}

mira_obj <- as.mira(dr_models_list)
final_pooled_dr <- pool(mira_obj)
pooled_summary <- summary(final_pooled_dr, conf.int = TRUE)

cat("\n--- Stage 3: 最终纵向双重稳健估计汇总结果 ---\n")
print(pooled_summary)
```

```{r}
# ====================================================================
# STEP 8: 准备可视化预测数据
# ====================================================================

# 1. 创建用于预测的虚拟数据集
# 保持协变量为基准值（参考学生画像）
pred_data <- expand.grid(
  class_type_K = c("Regular class", "Small class"),
  grade = c("K", "1", "2", "3"),
  student_race = "Non-Black",       # 设为基准组
  free_lunch_K = "Non-free lunch"   # 设为基准组
)

# 2. 确保 grade 是有序因子
pred_data$grade <- factor(pred_data$grade, levels = c("K", "1", "2", "3"))

# 3. 从汇总模型中提取系数 (Beta counts)
# 注意：这步需要手动构建，因为 pool() 后的对象不能直接 predict()
betas <- pooled_summary$estimate
names(betas) <- pooled_summary$term

term_or_zero <- function(term) {
  if (term %in% names(betas)) betas[[term]] else 0
}

# 4. 手动计算预测分值：允许初始小班效应随年级变化
pred_data <- pred_data %>%
  mutate(
    grade_main = case_when(
      grade == "K" ~ 0,
      grade == "1" ~ term_or_zero("grade1"),
      grade == "2" ~ term_or_zero("grade2"),
      grade == "3" ~ term_or_zero("grade3")
    ),
    treat_main = ifelse(class_type_K == "Small class",
                        term_or_zero("class_type_KSmall class"), 0),
    treat_grade = case_when(
      class_type_K == "Small class" & grade == "1" ~ term_or_zero("class_type_KSmall class:grade1"),
      class_type_K == "Small class" & grade == "2" ~ term_or_zero("class_type_KSmall class:grade2"),
      class_type_K == "Small class" & grade == "3" ~ term_or_zero("class_type_KSmall class:grade3"),
      TRUE ~ 0
    ),
    covar_adj = term_or_zero("student_raceNon-Black") +
      term_or_zero("free_lunch_KNon-free lunch"),
    predicted_score = term_or_zero("(Intercept)") + grade_main +
      treat_main + treat_grade + covar_adj
  ) %>%
  select(class_type_K, grade, predicted_score)

# 5. 计算每个年级的小班优势，便于和交互项解释对应
effect_by_grade <- tibble(
  grade = factor(c("K", "1", "2", "3"), levels = c("K", "1", "2", "3")),
  small_class_effect = c(
    term_or_zero("class_type_KSmall class"),
    term_or_zero("class_type_KSmall class") + term_or_zero("class_type_KSmall class:grade1"),
    term_or_zero("class_type_KSmall class") + term_or_zero("class_type_KSmall class:grade2"),
    term_or_zero("class_type_KSmall class") + term_or_zero("class_type_KSmall class:grade3")
  )
)

pred_data <- pred_data %>%
  left_join(effect_by_grade, by = "grade")
```

```{r}
# ====================================================================
# STEP 9: 绘制纵向成长曲线图 (AIPW + Mixed Model 修正版)
# ====================================================================

ggplot(pred_data, aes(x = grade, y = predicted_score, group = class_type_K, color = class_type_K)) +
  # 绘制折线
  geom_line(size = 1.2) +
  # 绘制数据点
  geom_point(size = 4, shape = 21, fill = "white") +
  
  # 设置坐标轴标签和标题
  labs(
    title = "K-3数学成绩轨迹：按幼儿园初始班型分组",
    subtitle = "参考学生画像下的预测值；模型允许初始小班效应随年级变化",
    x = "年级 (Grade)",
    y = "AIPW修正后预测数学成绩",
    color = "幼儿园初始班型"
  ) +
  
  # 美化主题
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, color = "gray30"),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  ) +
  
  # 设置颜色
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Regular class" = "#E41A1C", "Small class" = "#377EB8")) +
  
  # 添加分值标签
  geom_text(aes(label = round(predicted_score, 1)), vjust = -1.5, size = 3.5, show.legend = FALSE)

effect_by_grade %>%
  mutate(small_class_effect = round(small_class_effect, 2))
```
